meta.title: Entente
meta.description: The same thing occupies different places in different people's hearts.

units.rawText: Ascension Sector, in front of the Admin Center
units.displayText: Ascension Sector, in front of the Admin Center

spans.text: Ascension Sector, in front of the Admin Center

units.rawText: Before the group was up the steps, an agent clothed in white steps out of the doors.
units.displayText: Before the group was up the steps, an agent clothed in white steps out of the doors.

spans.text: Before the group was up the steps, an agent clothed in white steps out of the doors.

units.rawText: She swept her gaze across the ragtag bunch, bowing with an elegant smile.
units.displayText: She swept her gaze across the ragtag bunch, bowing with an elegant smile.

spans.text: She swept her gaze across the ragtag bunch, bowing with an elegant smile.

units.rawText: I've received communications. Welcome, emissaries of Arcadia.
units.displayText: I've received communications. Welcome, emissaries of Arcadia.

spans.text: I've received communications. Welcome, emissaries of Arcadia.

units.rawText: I am the administrator of the Ascension Sector, adjunct neuroengineering researcher, <color=orange>Elaugh</color>.
units.displayText: I am the administrator of the Ascension Sector, adjunct neuroengineering researcher, Elaugh.

spans.text: I am the administrator of the Ascension Sector, adjunct neuroengineering researcher,
Elaugh

units.rawText: I am Sueyoi, she's De Lacey, and this is Lind, who will be responsible for the data exchange...
units.displayText: I am Sueyoi, she's De Lacey, and this is Lind, who will be responsible for the data exchange...

spans.text: I am Sueyoi, she's De Lacey, and this is Lind, who will be responsible for the data exchange...

units.rawText: The administrator extended a hand. Sueyoi reached for it, but the administrator stepped past him, grasping Lind's hand instead.
units.displayText: The administrator extended a hand. Sueyoi reached for it, but the administrator stepped past him, grasping Lind's hand instead.

spans.text: The administrator extended a hand. Sueyoi reached for it, but the administrator stepped past him, grasping Lind's hand instead.

units.rawText: Huh?
units.displayText: Huh?

spans.text: Huh?

units.rawText: Hello, hello! You must be Miss Lind, yes? I'm already aware of the situation.
units.displayText: Hello, hello! You must be Miss Lind, yes? I'm already aware of the situation.

spans.text: Hello, hello! You must be Miss Lind, yes? I'm already aware of the situation.

units.rawText: The moment I saw you, I knew for sure that you've got exactly what I'm looking for!
units.displayText: The moment I saw you, I knew for sure that you've got exactly what I'm looking for!

spans.text: The moment I saw you, I knew for sure that you've got exactly what I'm looking for!

units.rawText: Uhh...
units.displayText: Uhh...

spans.text: Uhh...

units.rawText: That experimental data from UltiLife is bound to make this sector go far and beyond!
units.displayText: That experimental data from UltiLife is bound to make this sector go far and beyond!

spans.text: That experimental data from UltiLife is bound to make this sector go far and beyond!

units.rawText: Ah, well... ok, alright...
units.displayText: Ah, well... ok, alright...

spans.text: Ah, well... ok, alright...

units.rawText: Lind looked to her companions for help, not quite capable of handling the sudden approach.
units.displayText: Lind looked to her companions for help, not quite capable of handling the sudden approach.

spans.text: Lind looked to her companions for help, not quite capable of handling the sudden approach.

units.rawText: Miss Elaugh, let us talk business first.
units.displayText: Miss Elaugh, let us talk business first.

spans.text: Miss Elaugh, let us talk business first.

units.rawText: Oh, my apologies.
units.displayText: Oh, my apologies.

spans.text: Oh, my apologies.

units.rawText: Elaugh at last moved her sight off Lind. Her hand still grasped Lind's tightly, as if afraid she'd slip away into the ether.
units.displayText: Elaugh at last moved her sight off Lind. Her hand still grasped Lind's tightly, as if afraid she'd slip away into the ether.

spans.text: Elaugh at last moved her sight off Lind. Her hand still grasped Lind's tightly, as if afraid she'd slip away into the ether.

units.rawText: I never would have imagined that your delegation would have made it through the Sanctifier blockade this quickly. Here I was thinking that I'd have to expend a squad of agents to escort you in.
units.displayText: I never would have imagined that your delegation would have made it through the Sanctifier blockade this quickly. Here I was thinking that I'd have to expend a squad of agents to escort you in.

spans.text: I never would have imagined that your delegation would have made it through the Sanctifier blockade this quickly. Here I was thinking that I'd have to expend a squad of agents to escort you in.

units.rawText: Expend... agents?
units.displayText: Expend... agents?

spans.text: Expend... agents?

units.rawText: We slipped in amidst the chaos, along with all of your people.
units.displayText: We slipped in amidst the chaos, along with all of your people.

spans.text: We slipped in amidst the chaos, along with all of your people.

units.rawText: I see, now. You truly are adept at your craft.
units.displayText: I see, now. You truly are adept at your craft.

spans.text: I see, now. You truly are adept at your craft.

units.rawText: She said, turning around, dragging Lind towards the Admin Center.
units.displayText: She said, turning around, dragging Lind towards the Admin Center.

spans.text: She said, turning around, dragging Lind towards the Admin Center.

units.rawText: Time is running short, and I'll spare the pleasantries.
units.displayText: Time is running short, and I'll spare the pleasantries.

spans.text: Time is running short, and I'll spare the pleasantries.

units.rawText: As for the details of the transaction, I'm sure you have been made aware already. And now...
units.displayText: As for the details of the transaction, I'm sure you have been made aware already. And now...

spans.text: As for the details of the transaction, I'm sure you have been made aware already. And now...

units.rawText: A moment, Miss Elaugh.
units.displayText: A moment, Miss Elaugh.

spans.text: A moment, Miss Elaugh.

units.rawText: This agent's heavily hurt, and is in need of immediate care. What arrangements are there around here for healing the injured?
units.displayText: This agent's heavily hurt, and is in need of immediate care. What arrangements are there around here for healing the injured?

spans.text: This agent's heavily hurt, and is in need of immediate care. What arrangements are there around here for healing the injured?

units.rawText: Only then did Elaugh lay eyes on the injured agent. She smiled.
units.displayText: Only then did Elaugh lay eyes on the injured agent. She smiled.

spans.text: Only then did Elaugh lay eyes on the injured agent. She smiled.

units.rawText: Miss De Lacey, please do not trouble yourself with such trifling matters.
units.displayText: Miss De Lacey, please do not trouble yourself with such trifling matters.

spans.text: Miss De Lacey, please do not trouble yourself with such trifling matters.

units.rawText: ...What do you mean?
units.displayText: ...What do you mean?

spans.text: ...What do you mean?

units.rawText: There's no need for us to waste precious time on easily exchangeable spare parts, Miss De Lacey. Now, Miss Lind, please come with me.
units.displayText: There's no need for us to waste precious time on easily exchangeable spare parts, Miss De Lacey. Now, Miss Lind, please come with me.

spans.text: There's no need for us to waste precious time on easily exchangeable spare parts, Miss De Lacey. Now, Miss Lind, please come with me.

units.rawText: You—<size=50>just what do you think you're saying?</size>
units.displayText: You—just what do you think you're saying?

spans.text: You—
just what do you think you're saying?

units.rawText: Lind immediately puts her hand to De Lacey's. De Lacey's scowl remained fixated on the administrator, only easing after a good few seconds.
units.displayText: Lind immediately puts her hand to De Lacey's. De Lacey's scowl remained fixated on the administrator, only easing after a good few seconds.

spans.text: Lind immediately puts her hand to De Lacey's. De Lacey's scowl remained fixated on the administrator, only easing after a good few seconds.

units.rawText: She smiled at De Lacey, eyes still burning.
units.displayText: She smiled at De Lacey, eyes still burning.

spans.text: She smiled at De Lacey, eyes still burning.

units.rawText: My apologies, but I don't plan on giving up on a single agent.
units.displayText: My apologies, but I don't plan on giving up on a single agent.

spans.text: My apologies, but I don't plan on giving up on a single agent.

units.rawText: De Lacey, you...
units.displayText: De Lacey, you...

spans.text: De Lacey, you...

units.rawText: Miss Elaugh, I wish to trouble you for some prosthetic repair materials.
units.displayText: Miss Elaugh, I wish to trouble you for some prosthetic repair materials.

spans.text: Miss Elaugh, I wish to trouble you for some prosthetic repair materials.

units.rawText: I'll handle the processes myself, and won't take up a bit of your time. I can make arrangements for the costs of these materials to be repaid later as well.
units.displayText: I'll handle the processes myself, and won't take up a bit of your time. I can make arrangements for the costs of these materials to be repaid later as well.

spans.text: I'll handle the processes myself, and won't take up a bit of your time. I can make arrangements for the costs of these materials to be repaid later as well.

units.rawText: Elaugh's brows furled, a flash of displeasure crossing her countenance—but only for a moment.
units.displayText: Elaugh's brows furled, a flash of displeasure crossing her countenance—but only for a moment.

spans.text: Elaugh's brows furled, a flash of displeasure crossing her countenance—but only for a moment.

units.rawText: Hehe... then, seeing as you are an esteemed guest, I shall respect your decision. You may pay a visit to the Production Center, where our prosthetics are produced. Of course, pay no attention to whatever costs you may incur.
units.displayText: Hehe... then, seeing as you are an esteemed guest, I shall respect your decision. You may pay a visit to the Production Center, where our prosthetics are produced. Of course, pay no attention to whatever costs you may incur.

spans.text: Hehe... then, seeing as you are an esteemed guest, I shall respect your decision. You may pay a visit to the Production Center, where our prosthetics are produced. Of course, pay no attention to whatever costs you may incur.

units.rawText: Understood. Thank you kindly.
units.displayText: Understood. Thank you kindly.

spans.text: Understood. Thank you kindly.

units.rawText: Noting down the coordinates, De Lacey turned around, leaving with the agent.
units.displayText: Noting down the coordinates, De Lacey turned around, leaving with the agent.

spans.text: Noting down the coordinates, De Lacey turned around, leaving with the agent.

units.rawText: De Lacey, we have a job to do here.
units.displayText: De Lacey, we have a job to do here.

spans.text: De Lacey, we have a job to do here.

units.rawText: She stopped, turning around, an apologetic smile on her face.
units.displayText: She stopped, turning around, an apologetic smile on her face.

spans.text: She stopped, turning around, an apologetic smile on her face.

units.rawText: Suu, Linny, you two go along with Miss Elaugh first.
units.displayText: Suu, Linny, you two go along with Miss Elaugh first.

spans.text: Suu, Linny, you two go along with Miss Elaugh first.

units.rawText: Inside the Admin Center, the administrator led Lind along by the hand. Sueyoi lagged a few half-steps behind, taking in the surroundings.
units.displayText: Inside the Admin Center, the administrator led Lind along by the hand. Sueyoi lagged a few half-steps behind, taking in the surroundings.

spans.text: Inside the Admin Center, the administrator led Lind along by the hand. Sueyoi lagged a few half-steps behind, taking in the surroundings.

units.rawText: I hope you understand, I've no intention of picking a fight with her. Time is of the essence.
units.displayText: I hope you understand, I've no intention of picking a fight with her. Time is of the essence.

spans.text: I hope you understand, I've no intention of picking a fight with her. Time is of the essence.

units.rawText: The Ascension Sector has been under siege since time immemorial, and inevitable Sanctifier breaches happen from time to time.
units.displayText: The Ascension Sector has been under siege since time immemorial, and inevitable Sanctifier breaches happen from time to time.

spans.text: The Ascension Sector has been under siege since time immemorial, and inevitable Sanctifier breaches happen from time to time.

units.rawText: I'm also getting wind that a Greater Sanctifier's going to be at the reins soon. We must finish our exchange before then.
units.displayText: I'm also getting wind that a Greater Sanctifier's going to be at the reins soon. We must finish our exchange before then.

spans.text: I'm also getting wind that a Greater Sanctifier's going to be at the reins soon. We must finish our exchange before then.

units.rawText: I understand.
units.displayText: I understand.

spans.text: I understand.

units.rawText: Thank you.
units.displayText: Thank you.

spans.text: Thank you.

units.rawText: In accordance with our previous agreements, we provide you with data, and you provide your administrative rights so we can search for our "target" within the sector.
units.displayText: In accordance with our previous agreements, we provide you with data, and you provide your administrative rights so we can search for our "target" within the sector.

spans.text: In accordance with our previous agreements, we provide you with data, and you provide your administrative rights so we can search for our "target" within the sector.

units.rawText: Of course. Before then, I'd appreciate it if you could show me the equipment you plan to use for your searching.
units.displayText: Of course. Before then, I'd appreciate it if you could show me the equipment you plan to use for your searching.

spans.text: Of course. Before then, I'd appreciate it if you could show me the equipment you plan to use for your searching.

units.rawText: Sure.
units.displayText: Sure.

spans.text: Sure.

units.rawText: Sueyoi produced a terminal, tapping away at it. A display appeared between the two, hovering in the air.
units.displayText: Sueyoi produced a terminal, tapping away at it. A display appeared between the two, hovering in the air.

spans.text: Sueyoi produced a terminal, tapping away at it. A display appeared between the two, hovering in the air.

units.rawText: Elaugh carefully scrutinized the data streams in front of her.
units.displayText: Elaugh carefully scrutinized the data streams in front of her.

spans.text: Elaugh carefully scrutinized the data streams in front of her.

units.rawText: Alright, no known viruses contained within.
units.displayText: Alright, no known viruses contained within.

spans.text: Alright, no known viruses contained within.

units.rawText: To agree to an exchange like this in the first place, surely you would know beforehand that Arcadia does not go back on its word.
units.displayText: To agree to an exchange like this in the first place, surely you would know beforehand that Arcadia does not go back on its word.

spans.text: To agree to an exchange like this in the first place, surely you would know beforehand that Arcadia does not go back on its word.

units.rawText: Naturally. Only a customary inspection—I must take responsibility for the entire sector.
units.displayText: Naturally. Only a customary inspection—I must take responsibility for the entire sector.

spans.text: Naturally. Only a customary inspection—I must take responsibility for the entire sector.

units.rawText: Is there anything else required of me?
units.displayText: Is there anything else required of me?

spans.text: Is there anything else required of me?

units.rawText: No. Plug in your administrative rights, and it'll run a search for our "target" in the entire sector.
units.displayText: No. Plug in your administrative rights, and it'll run a search for our "target" in the entire sector.

spans.text: No. Plug in your administrative rights, and it'll run a search for our "target" in the entire sector.

units.rawText: As you might have assumed, I'll have to leave the rest of the process to your speculation.
units.displayText: As you might have assumed, I'll have to leave the rest of the process to your speculation.

spans.text: As you might have assumed, I'll have to leave the rest of the process to your speculation.

units.rawText: By all means. It's good to keep secrets for both of us.
units.displayText: By all means. It's good to keep secrets for both of us.

spans.text: By all means. It's good to keep secrets for both of us.

units.rawText: As expected of Irregulars who've held up under Sanctifier siege for this long.
units.displayText: As expected of Irregulars who've held up under Sanctifier siege for this long.

spans.text: As expected of Irregulars who've held up under Sanctifier siege for this long.

units.rawText: Your rights, then?
units.displayText: Your rights, then?

spans.text: Your rights, then?

units.rawText: Sueyoi gestured at the port on the terminal, but Elaugh shook her head.
units.displayText: Sueyoi gestured at the port on the terminal, but Elaugh shook her head.

spans.text: Sueyoi gestured at the port on the terminal, but Elaugh shook her head.

units.rawText: There are more terms to this exchange, no?
units.displayText: There are more terms to this exchange, no?

spans.text: There are more terms to this exchange, no?

units.rawText: You must provide me with Lind's data before I lend the administrative rights to you. That was the agreement.
units.displayText: You must provide me with Lind's data before I lend the administrative rights to you. That was the agreement.

spans.text: You must provide me with Lind's data before I lend the administrative rights to you. That was the agreement.

units.rawText: And these two cannot happen simultaneously?
units.displayText: And these two cannot happen simultaneously?

spans.text: And these two cannot happen simultaneously?

units.rawText: I require the administrative rights as well for the logging of data.
units.displayText: I require the administrative rights as well for the logging of data.

spans.text: I require the administrative rights as well for the logging of data.

units.rawText: Tch, what a pain...
units.displayText: Tch, what a pain...

spans.text: Tch, what a pain...

units.rawText: Well, I suppose it's no matter to me, but there better not be any funny busi—
units.displayText: Well, I suppose it's no matter to me, but there better not be any funny busi—

spans.text: Well, I suppose it's no matter to me, but there better not be any funny busi—

units.rawText: <size=50>BOOM!</size>
units.displayText: BOOM!

spans.text: BOOM!

units.rawText: An explosion came from outside the Admin Center.
units.displayText: An explosion came from outside the Admin Center.

spans.text: An explosion came from outside the Admin Center.

units.rawText: <size=50>What?!</size>
units.displayText: What?!

spans.text: What?!

units.rawText: Ah... here they come again.
units.displayText: Ah... here they come again.

spans.text: Ah... here they come again.

units.rawText: Another wave of... Sanctifier attacks?
units.displayText: Another wave of... Sanctifier attacks?

spans.text: Another wave of... Sanctifier attacks?

units.rawText: (Incoming Communication Alert)
units.displayText: (Incoming Communication Alert)

spans.text: (Incoming Communication Alert)

units.rawText: <size=50>Suu!</size>
units.displayText: Suu!

spans.text: Suu!

units.rawText: De Lacey? What's the situation?
units.displayText: De Lacey? What's the situation?

spans.text: De Lacey? What's the situation?

units.rawText: A Sanctifier squad's broken in, this time around the path to the Production Center!
units.displayText: A Sanctifier squad's broken in, this time around the path to the Production Center!

spans.text: A Sanctifier squad's broken in, this time around the path to the Production Center!

units.rawText: Already? Are you in danger?
units.displayText: Already? Are you in danger?

spans.text: Already? Are you in danger?

units.rawText: There's not many, and I could handle them myself, but...
units.displayText: There's not many, and I could handle them myself, but...

spans.text: There's not many, and I could handle them myself, but...

units.rawText: You've got injured on your hands.
units.displayText: You've got injured on your hands.

spans.text: You've got injured on your hands.

units.rawText: Tch, alright! Give me your co-ords!
units.displayText: Tch, alright! Give me your co-ords!

spans.text: Tch, alright! Give me your co-ords!

units.rawText: Sueyoi closed the line, glancing sideways at Elaugh. She responded to his gaze in kind.
units.displayText: Sueyoi closed the line, glancing sideways at Elaugh. She responded to his gaze in kind.

spans.text: Sueyoi closed the line, glancing sideways at Elaugh. She responded to his gaze in kind.

units.rawText: Time is of the essence indeed...
units.displayText: Time is of the essence indeed...

spans.text: Time is of the essence indeed...

units.rawText: Don't need you to tell me.
units.displayText: Don't need you to tell me.

spans.text: Don't need you to tell me.

units.rawText: You do not understand yet. We fight a losing war against the Sanctifiers, and here is the battlefield we stand on.
units.displayText: You do not understand yet. We fight a losing war against the Sanctifiers, and here is the battlefield we stand on.

spans.text: You do not understand yet. We fight a losing war against the Sanctifiers, and here is the battlefield we stand on.

units.rawText: The very ground has the chance to be pummeled into ruins by our enemies. There's no time to give such attention to every agent.
units.displayText: The very ground has the chance to be pummeled into ruins by our enemies. There's no time to give such attention to every agent.

spans.text: The very ground has the chance to be pummeled into ruins by our enemies. There's no time to give such attention to every agent.

units.rawText: You should follow your own advice all the more, then. Let's get a move on.
units.displayText: You should follow your own advice all the more, then. Let's get a move on.

spans.text: You should follow your own advice all the more, then. Let's get a move on.

units.rawText: Lind, go log whatever data you need. As fast as you can.
units.displayText: Lind, go log whatever data you need. As fast as you can.

spans.text: Lind, go log whatever data you need. As fast as you can.

units.rawText: Hold onto this, too. The sooner you're done, the faster we can get on with the search. Don't dawdle.
units.displayText: Hold onto this, too. The sooner you're done, the faster we can get on with the search. Don't dawdle.

spans.text: Hold onto this, too. The sooner you're done, the faster we can get on with the search. Don't dawdle.

units.rawText: He stuffed the terminal into Lind's hands. She took it into her hands, giving Sueyoi a wave.
units.displayText: He stuffed the terminal into Lind's hands. She took it into her hands, giving Sueyoi a wave.

spans.text: He stuffed the terminal into Lind's hands. She took it into her hands, giving Sueyoi a wave.

units.rawText: Alright, off you go.
units.displayText: Alright, off you go.

spans.text: Alright, off you go.

units.rawText: Contact me if anything comes up. Don't screw up the job Boss gave us!
units.displayText: Contact me if anything comes up. Don't screw up the job Boss gave us!

spans.text: Contact me if anything comes up. Don't screw up the job Boss gave us!

units.rawText: Leaving those words behind, Sueyoi ran towards the building's exit, weapon in hand.
units.displayText: Leaving those words behind, Sueyoi ran towards the building's exit, weapon in hand.

spans.text: Leaving those words behind, Sueyoi ran towards the building's exit, weapon in hand.

units.rawText: Decisive analysis, finding one's next move in an instant. He's your leader, I take it?
units.displayText: Decisive analysis, finding one's next move in an instant. He's your leader, I take it?

spans.text: Decisive analysis, finding one's next move in an instant. He's your leader, I take it?

units.rawText: Leader's a big word, we're just told to go do things together.
units.displayText: Leader's a big word, we're just told to go do things together.

spans.text: Leader's a big word, we're just told to go do things together.

units.rawText: I just do my part of the job.
units.displayText: I just do my part of the job.

spans.text: I just do my part of the job.

units.rawText: When you're carrying out a mission, is it not desirable to have someone in command?
units.displayText: When you're carrying out a mission, is it not desirable to have someone in command?

spans.text: When you're carrying out a mission, is it not desirable to have someone in command?

units.rawText: To simply commit yourself to your orders, and to think of nothing else... is it not a thing of beauty?
units.displayText: To simply commit yourself to your orders, and to think of nothing else... is it not a thing of beauty?

spans.text: To simply commit yourself to your orders, and to think of nothing else... is it not a thing of beauty?

units.rawText: What are you getting at?
units.displayText: What are you getting at?

spans.text: What are you getting at?

units.rawText: Hah, nothing. Let's get going with our little transaction.
units.displayText: Hah, nothing. Let's get going with our little transaction.

spans.text: Hah, nothing. Let's get going with our little transaction.

units.rawText: It's just us two now. Let's see what technology you have in store for me.
units.displayText: It's just us two now. Let's see what technology you have in store for me.

spans.text: It's just us two now. Let's see what technology you have in store for me.
